meta.title: Theme editor
meta.description: Every design token of the component, editable, with the CSS for what you changed.

intro: Every value below is a custom property the component reads at run time, generated from its own stylesheet. Change one and the schedule under the panel follows; when you are done, the block at the bottom is the CSS to paste into your application. Nothing here is stored — a reload brings the defaults back.

tokens.changed: {count, plural, =0 {nothing changed} one {# changed} other {# changed}}

stage.error: That value is one the browser cannot use. Reset the token you changed last, or start again with Reset all.

css.intro: Paste this where your own stylesheet loads, after the package’s. Only what you changed is here.
css.empty: Change a token and its CSS appears here, ready to copy.
